description: osirAppCreateUpload: ONLY for a client with a shell and a project too large to send inline (over 500 files or 6 MiB). Usually you do NOT need this: call osirAppDeploy with the project's files directly. Returns an uploadTicket, a putUrl, and instructions to zip the project and PUT it there; then call osirAppDeploy with the uploadTicket. Requires authentication.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: osirAppCreateUpload
